{"meetingId": "941", "tickets": [
{"title": "Review Debt Refinance Opportunity", "templateId": "fcc97859-b94b-574b-9ef8-66594525339a", "text": "Compare current loan terms with proposed refinance terms, including rate, term, payment change, closing costs, break-even period, cash flow impact, and planning risks before advising next steps. Prepare a side-by-side review for Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed covering the current 7/1 adjustable loan at Teacup Comet Bank (3.25% now, projected reset to about 6.875%; payment rising from about $4,120 to about $5,980 per month), a fixed-rate refinance quote from Silver Marmot Mortgage, and a no-cash-out quote from Teacup Comet Bank, including payment change, closing costs, break-even period, and impact on the $94,000 cash reserves.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2024-10-25", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Daria asked for a side-by-side review of the current adjustable loan, a fixed-rate refinance quote from Silver Marmot Mortgage, and a no-cash-out quote from Teacup Comet Bank, including payment change, closing costs, break-even period, and cash reserve impact. The agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison for October 25, 2024."},
{"title": "Obtain current debt documents for loan analysis", "templateId": null, "text": "Collect from Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed the current mortgage note, the most recent HELOC statement from Teacup Comet Bank, the HELOC draw-period terms, and payoff figures for the credit cards (about $28,400 across two cards) and the auto loan ($31,600 balance) so restructuring options can be tested using current balances and terms.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-10-24", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to obtain those documents to test restructuring options using current balances and terms by October 24, 2024."},
{"title": "Resolve HELOC limit and advance availability discrepancy", "templateId": null, "text": "Confirm with Teacup Comet Bank the actual HELOC limit and draw status for Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed, whose household spreadsheet lists a $200,000 limit while the bank portal screenshot shows a lower available line and a message that new advances are restricted.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-10-30", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The actual limit and draw status remain unresolved and need follow-up by October 30, 2024."},
{"title": "Develop cash-flow bridge plan for higher loan payments", "templateId": null, "text": "Develop a bridge plan for Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed covering the projected combined increase in the mortgage and HELOC payments that creates a monthly shortfall in the household worksheet, using bonus timing, reserve thresholds (Daria wants emergency reserves kept above $60,000), and discretionary spending reductions.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-11-08", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to develop that bridge plan for November 8, 2024."},
{"title": "Test high-interest debt repayment sequence", "templateId": null, "text": "Test the payoff order for Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed's high-interest consumer debt (about $28,400 of credit card balances at 18.9%–22.4%) against liquidity needs rather than simply paying the smallest balance first, given the materially higher rates versus secured debt.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-10-29", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to test the repayment sequence by October 29, 2024."},
{"title": "Review Concentrated Position", "templateId": "b835d25d-d355-5804-8593-94348f4d26b8", "text": "Evaluate a concentrated position for portfolio risk, tax exposure, liquidity needs, restrictions, and diversification options. Use placeholders for the client, ticker/security, custodian, cost basis, holding period, and any trading limitations. For Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed, compare taxes, concentration risk, and interest savings from using the taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody (about $620,000, including about $235,000 of Clockwork Clover Biologics stock with an estimated cost basis of $74,000) to retire the credit card debt and reduce the $146,000 HELOC at Teacup Comet Bank.", "priority": "high", "dueDate": "2024-10-31", "assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465", "subTasks": [
{"title": "Assemble Position Facts", "text": "Collect current market value, share count, cost basis, acquisition history, holding period, account registration, and any employer equity plan details for the Clockwork Clover Biologics stock held at Velvet Acorn Custody (about $235,000 with an estimated cost basis of $74,000). Confirm whether blackout windows, lockups, Rule 144, or insider restrictions may apply.", "priority": "high", "assigneeId": "47926d53-db41-532d-99c2-224dc3aaa5ea", "dueDate": null},
{"title": "Model Portfolio and Tax Impact", "text": "Analyze concentration percentage, sector exposure, volatility, unrealized gain or loss, charitable giving opportunities, tax-loss offsets, and estimated tax impact under phased-sale scenarios for the Clockwork Clover Biologics position.", "priority": "high", "assigneeId": "96c9c35b-0519-5544-bd5f-e8e441dccdb2", "dueDate": null},
{"title": "Draft Diversification Recommendation", "text": "Prepare a client-ready summary comparing hold, trim, staged sale, gifting, hedging, and reinvestment options, including using proceeds to retire the credit card debt and reduce the HELOC. Include key assumptions, open questions for the CPA or attorney, and next-step implementation considerations.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465", "dueDate": null}
], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to compare taxes, concentration risk, and interest savings by October 31, 2024."},
{"title": "Coordinate tax planning with Cora Bramblequill", "templateId": null, "text": "Coordinate with Cora Bramblequill at Paper Otter Tax Studio so that any sale of Clockwork Clover Biologics stock, use of bonus proceeds, or change in withholding by Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed is reflected in estimated tax planning.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-11-06", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to coordinate that tax planning by November 6, 2024."},
{"title": "Update household income estimate after contract change", "templateId": null, "text": "Obtain an updated estimate of Liam Velvetreed's expected business revenue and expenses at Buttonwood Balloon Studio, since his largest design contract is winding down and the refinance application will use current household income.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-11-05", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "An updated estimate of Liam’s expected business revenue and expenses remains needed by November 5, 2024."},
{"title": "Address HELOC account aggregation feed issue", "templateId": null, "text": "Resolve the planning portal's HELOC feed for Daria Velvetreed, which has not updated the Teacup Comet Bank HELOC balance for several weeks and still shows the old interest-only payment (about $1,065 per month), affecting the cash-flow projection used during the meeting.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-10-23", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to address the HELOC feed issue by October 23, 2024."},
{"title": "Obtain current insurance declarations for refinance", "templateId": null, "text": "Obtain current homeowners and umbrella coverage declarations for Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed, who carry a $2 million umbrella liability policy through Amber Teapot Insurance, since the refinance package checklist references these documents and only an older homeowners declaration page was available.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-11-04", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to obtain current insurance declarations by November 4, 2024."},
{"title": "Obtain trust certification and title vesting evidence", "templateId": null, "text": "Obtain the trust certification and title vesting evidence for Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed's Portland, Oregon home, which appears titled in the household revocable trust established with Nolan Fablethimble at Thimble Harbor Law Group, as referenced on the lender underwriting checklist.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-11-01", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Those trust and title materials remain needed by November 1, 2024."},
{"title": "Summarize rate-lock trade-offs and open risks", "templateId": null, "text": "Summarize for Daria Velvetreed and Liam Velvetreed the financial trade-offs and open risks of the refinance quote with a limited rate-lock window before the household decides whether to proceed with that lender.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-10-27", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to summarize the financial trade-offs and open risks before the household decides whether to proceed with that lender, with a date of October 27, 2024."}
]}
